principles: RTL first: every flow, layout, stepper, navigation, and canvas mirror is crafted for authentic Arabic reading order.
Spiritual Depth: deep obsidian-sapphire background (#071827) paired with refined gold accents (#E7B85C) and clear action blues (#2563EB).
Quranic Typography Honor: dedicated Amiri Quran & Scheherazade New for sacred text with proper diacritics and ayah separators (۝ / ﴾ ﴿ / octagons), and crisp IBM Plex Sans Arabic for UI controls.

Fluid Studio Power: 6-step video generator with real-time responsive HTML5 Canvas preview, word highlighting, waveform visualizer, audio synthesis/playback sync, and export presets (9:16 reels/shorts, 16:9 youtube, 1:1 feed, 4:5 instagram).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `dir='rtl'` and `lang='ar'` are set on `<html lang='ar' dir='rtl'>` in `frontend/index.html` and add `class='dark'` to html tag.

Import Arabic fonts in `index.css`: use `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans-arabic` and `@fontsource/amiri` or Google/CDN fallback `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Amiri+Quran&family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Scheherazade+New:wght@400;700&display=swap');` for flawless rendering of Quranic glyphs.

Seed a comprehensive mock dataset of all 114 Surahs with Arabic names, verse counts, revelation type (مكية / مدنية), English transliteration, and full verse texts with tafsir and reciter audio URLs (e.g. Mishary Alafasy, Abdulbasit Abdulsamad, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Minshawi).

Implement the 6-Step Studio with real HTML5 Canvas render loop: it must draw backgrounds (images/gradient video loops), calculate multi-line wrapped Arabic text with Quran font, render decorative frames/borders, draw audio visualizer bars, highlight active words, and support exporting as MP4/WebM using MediaRecorder or high-res frame capture download.

Include pre-made studio templates: 'التهجد الليلي' (Deep Sapphire + Gold), 'الفجر والسكينة' (Dawn Glow + Soft White), 'تلاوة مهيبة' (Sultan Mosque + Geometric Gold Frame), 'القصص والتدبر' (Minimalist Serif + Subtitle translation).
Ensure sticky bottom Quran audio bar stays accessible and smoothly synchronizes with verse reading highlight.
Do NOT include Duas or Ziyarat sections — strictly maintain focus on Quran Library and Quran Studio as specified.
Add explicit `data-testid` attributes to all action buttons, inputs, tabs, and cards following the specified conventions.
